info.title: dubstack docs runtime API
info.description: Public runtime endpoints exposed by each published dubstack docs site, plus selected server-side Admin API endpoints for trusted automation. Docs runtime endpoints are scoped to the site that serves them. Admin API endpoints use https://api.dubstack.ai and require server-side Admin API keys.

post.description: Handles Streamable HTTP JSON-RPC requests for the public docs MCP server. MCP clients use this endpoint to initialize the connection, list tools, and call tools such as documentation search or virtual filesystem reads. The endpoint is stateless, public, and scoped to published docs content for the current site.

fullIndex.value:
# dubstack docs

## Quickstart
Launch a docs site, connect Git, customize content, and publish.

## Public MCP
dubstack exposes read-only retrieval tools so agents can search and inspect published docs. When enabled, agents can also submit documentation-quality feedback.

post.description: Sends a reader question to the public docs assistant for the current site. The assistant answers from published documentation and returns source links when retrieval finds relevant pages. This endpoint is intended for the public reader widget and should be treated as an AI-generated response surface, not a source of dashboard administration state.

value.message: How do I connect a custom domain?

requestBody.description: Reader question and optional current-page context for the public assistant widget.

200.description: Assistant response generated from published documentation, with optional source citations.

value.answer: Open Settings, choose Domain setup, enter your domain, then add the DNS records shown in the dashboard. Once DNS propagates, verify the domain and publish your site.

503.description: Assistant backend is unavailable or disabled for the current site.

get.description: Loads a published OpenAPI specification for the current docs site. Generated API reference pages and the browser request builder use this endpoint to read the same parsed spec metadata, base URL fallback, and operation definitions that were published during the latest sync.

parameters.name: spec
parameters.description: Spec name configured in dubstack.json. Omit this parameter to load the default API reference spec.

parameters.name: branch
parameters.description: Optional preview branch identifier used when rendering branch preview docs.

200.description: Published OpenAPI spec metadata together with the parsed OpenAPI document.

404.description: No published spec exists for the requested site, spec name, or preview branch.

post.description: Proxies a reader-triggered playground request to a target URL allowed by the published OpenAPI spec. The proxy keeps browser playground calls scoped to documented public origins, blocks private or reserved network targets, and avoids placing tenant credentials in frontend code.

requestBody.description: Request generated by the browser playground for a documented operation and allowed target URL.

200.description: Captured upstream response returned to the browser playground.

403.description: Target origin or URL is not allowed by the published OpenAPI spec or playground security policy.

post.description: Records feedback for the current published docs site. Use this endpoint for page ratings, assistant answer ratings, and trusted application feedback integrations when the corresponding deployment add-on is enabled. Public MCP clients should call the advertised submit_feedback MCP tool instead of posting to this HTTP endpoint directly. Requests are tenant-scoped by the docs site host and rate-limited per site and client IP.

requestBody.description: Feedback payload submitted by a docs reader, assistant UI, or agent feedback surface.

value.message: Positive page rating for OpenAPI setup
The assistant answer linked to a dashboard screen that has moved.

201.description: Feedback event accepted and stored for the current deployment.

400.description: The message, rating, reader email, or JSON body is invalid.

403.description: The relevant feedback or assistant add-on is disabled for the current site.

value.error: Agent feedback is disabled for this site

413.description: The feedback message is larger than the accepted payload size.

429.description: Too many feedback requests were submitted for the site and client IP in the current rate-limit window.

Retry-After.description: Number of seconds to wait before retrying.

X-RateLimit-Limit.description: Maximum feedback requests allowed in the current window.

X-RateLimit-Remaining.description: Remaining feedback requests in the current window.

X-RateLimit-Reset.description: Unix timestamp, in seconds, when the current rate-limit window resets.

500.description: The feedback event could not be recorded.

x-codeSamples.label: Submit page feedback
x-codeSamples.source:
curl --request POST \
  --url https://dubstack.ai/docs/feedback \
  --header 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  --data '{
    "source": "page-feedback",
    "rating": "up",
    "message": "This page answered my setup question.",
    "page_path": "/api-reference/openapi-setup",
    "page_url": "https://dubstack.ai/docs/api-reference/openapi-setup"
  }'
